audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male narrator begins with a high-arousal, energetic welcome, introducing a BBQ restaurant. Upbeat synth-pop background music starts immediately at a moderate-fast tempo. Loud, crisp sizzling SFX of meat hitting the grill is layered under the voice. (2) A distinct "snip" sound of scissors cutting meat marks the transition. The narrator lists specific meat types with clear, enthusiastic articulation. (3) Continuous upbeat music. The narrator describes the grilling service. Soft rustling sounds of fresh vegetables are audible. (4) Clinking sounds of ceramic bowls and metal tongs against the grill provide a rhythmic acoustic texture. Narrator explains the set meal details. (5) Bubbling liquid SFX signals the presentation of the soup. The vocal pitch remains relatively high and positive. (6) A sharp "clink" of glasses marks a celebratory beverage shot. (7) The narrator delivers a concluding tagline with the restaurant's address, ending on a rising, friendly intonation as the music fades out.
